Accessibility

Choose how focus looks

Pick the focus indicator that works best for you. It applies right away, everywhere on this site.

When you move through a page with the Tab key, a ring appears around the thing you are on — a button, a link, a box to type in. That ring is called the focus indicator. It is how you know where you are, the same way a cursor shows where you are typing.

One size does not fit everyone. Some people want a thin, quiet ring. Some want a thick one that is easy to find on a busy page. Some want a color that stands out no matter what is behind it. Here you can choose for yourself — pick a style below and it takes effect immediately, on every page of this site.
